quarterly_data.signal: onsemi's 10-Q: remaining performance obligations under Long-term Supply Agreements (LTSAs) were approximately $6.1 billion as of July 3, 2026, with approximately 37% expected to be recognized as revenue over the next 12 months. Revenue recognized from contract liabilities (which include non-cancellable customer capacity payments) outstanding at the prior year end was $12.9 million in the quarter ended July 3, 2026 versus $24.4 million in the quarter ended July 4, 2025. Capital expenditures were approximately 2% of revenue in the six months ended July 3, 2026, and onsemi expects capital expenditures of less than 5% of revenue for 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: LTSA remaining performance obligations ~$6.1 billion (July 3, 2026), ~37% over next 12 months; H1 2026 capex ~2% of revenue; 2026 capex <5% of revenue
